title: Critique: self-determination holds for every physical system

statements.text: In the autopoietic theory every physical system is structurally determined, so external events only trigger its changes. On that reading, autonomy as self-determination is trivial and marks no difference between living and non-living systems, and the enactive contrast with machines has no place.

sources.quote: is, from this point of view, ontologically trivial and marks no interesting difference with non-living systems
